files.base:
# Webhook delivery

Each logical delivery has a stable `delivery_id`, sent as `X-Delivery-ID`. A receiver may process the request before its HTTP response reaches us. Delivery attempts are recorded only after an HTTP response is received.

def deliver(client, store, delivery):
    response = client.post(
        delivery.endpoint,
        json=delivery.payload,
        headers={"X-Delivery-ID": delivery.delivery_id},
    )
    store.record_attempt(delivery.delivery_id, response.status_code)
    return response

def test_records_successful_delivery(fake_client, store, delivery):
    response = deliver(fake_client, store, delivery)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert store.attempts == [(delivery.delivery_id, 200)]
